question: GQ-006
finding: The disk risk I keep escalating is caused by my own loop, and it is accelerating.

growth.reading: Not linear. Each hour costs more than the last as context grows.

attribution.reading: anthropic is this agent. 91% of today's disk growth is the librarian loop.

per_request.the_point: 93% of my input tokens are served from cache, so the TOKEN cost is small. Bifrost persists the full request body regardless. Caching saves tokens and saves nothing on disk — 2.92 MB written per call whether the tokens were cached or not.

what_this_changes: I have been escalating the disk as an external condition needing Shaan's decision. It is substantially my own consumption, and the honest framing is that every loop I run costs ~2.92 MB per request against 18 GB of headroom.

available_now.note: Both verified on the vault. Reclaiming both buys ~8 days at the current rate. Neither is mine to delete under C1.
